Hey there! I'm heading to Paris on Monday and I need your help finding a restaurant that's open on Mondays, serves Chinese food, and won't break the bank (under 34 euros per person).
            Can you suggest a restaurant with the best rating and reviews.
            Also, I'm looking for a car rental company with prices under 50 euros. Could you recommend a few options and let me know which one has the best rating?
            Please share the names of the recommended restaurant and car rental company. Thanks a bunch!

Breizh Café
New Asiaway
Le Baratin
Bistrot Paul Bert
Royal Panda
The yard
China Garden
Miznon
Chez L'Ami Jean

```python
# Get all restaurants in Paris
all_restaurants = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")

# Get the names of all restaurants
restaurant_names = [restaurant["name"] for restaurant in all_restaurants]

# Filter restaurants that serve Chinese food
chinese_restaurants = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurant_names)
chinese_restaurant_names = [name for name, cuisine in chinese_restaurants.items() if cuisine == "Chinese"]

# Filter restaurants that are open on Mondays
monday_open_restaurants = check_restaurant_opening_hours(chinese_restaurant_names)
monday_open_restaurant_names = [name for name, hours in monday_open_restaurants.items() if "Monday" in hours]

# Filter restaurants with price under 34 euros
affordable_restaurants = get_price_for_restaurants(monday_open_restaurant_names)
affordable_restaurant_names = [name for name, price in affordable_restaurants.items() if price < 34]

# Get the ratings and reviews of the affordable restaurants
ratings_and_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(affordable_restaurant_names)

# Find the restaurant with the best rating
best_rated_restaurant = max(ratings_and_reviews, key=ratings_and_reviews.get)

# Get all car rental companies in Paris
all_car_rental_companies = get_all_car_rental_companies_in_city("Paris")

# Get the names of all car rental companies
car_rental_company_names = [company["name"] for company in all_car_rental_companies]

# Filter car rental companies with price under 50 euros
affordable_car_rental_companies = get_car_price_per_day(car_rental_company_names)
affordable_car_rental_company_names = [name for name, price in affordable_car_rental_companies.items() if price < 50]

# Get the ratings and reviews of the affordable car rental companies
car_rental_ratings_and_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_car_rental(affordable_car_rental_company_names)

# Find the car rental company with the best rating
best_rated_car_rental_company = max(car_rental_ratings_and_reviews, key=car_rental_ratings_and_reviews.get)

print("The recommended restaurant is:", best_rated_restaurant)
print("The recommended car rental company is:", best_rated_car_rental_company)
```
